data.one_liner: Wraps hrana to connect drift to remote libsql/Turso databases
data.what_it_does: Provides a Drift-compatible database implementation that talks to a remote libsql server over WebSocket. It handles connection, authentication, and migration without requiring local SQLite.
use_when: You need to use drift with a remote Turso/libsql backend
You want a single database instance shared across devices via a server
avoid_when: You only need local storage or a different backend like SQLite or Firebase
data.setup_notes: Add drift_hrana to pubspec, run a libsql server (e.g., via Docker), import HranaDatabase and pass it to your Drift database constructor

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use local SQLite instead of a remote server
